outcome: Identification of upstream regulators of labour
cohort: The study utilized human myometrial cells and preterm human myometrium samples, alongside publicly available datasets, to investigate molecular mechanisms of labour.
finding: Overexpression of TBX2 in myometrial cells leads to downregulation of TNFa- and interferon signalling, and TBX2 represses a subset of upstream regulators common to both preterm and term labour.
